relatedItems.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在奥斯汀的自由练习中，尽管FP1表现不佳，但在FP2中有所改进，车队认为车辆的方向正确。

relatedItems.originalTitle: 💬 “It's been a useful day for us on track as we continue to build our knowledge around our update package. Whilst the car wasn't in a great place ...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
💬 “It's been a useful day for us on track as we continue to build our knowledge around our update package. Whilst the car wasn't in a great place in FP1, we made some good improvements for FP2 and definitely moved the car in the right direction.”
Hear from Kimi, George and Shov after the Austin free practices 👉https://bit.ly/USAFridayReportTW
detailZh:
💬 “今天我们在赛道上的表现对我们来说很有用，因为我们继续积累关于我们更新套件的知识。虽然赛车在FP1中表现不佳，但我们为FP2做出了一些改进，并且确实将赛车推向了正确的方向。”
听听基米、乔治和肖夫在奥斯汀自由练习后的看法👉https://bit.ly/USAFridayReportTW
detailEn:
💬 “It's been a useful day for us on track as we continue to build our knowledge around our update package. Whilst the car wasn't in a great place in FP1, we made some good improvements for FP2 and definitely moved the car in the right direction.”
Hear from Kimi, George and Shov after the Austin free practices 👉https://bit.ly/USAFridayReportTW
